name: Scholarship to Poor Students
benefit: Under this scheme, one student from each undergraduate and postgraduate class at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University is awarded a scholarship equal to the tuition fee of their respective class.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The student must be enrolled in an undergraduate or postgraduate course at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University. 1. The student must have the lowest annual family income among all students in the same course, class, or subject.
